angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 296,368 km at 22.08 pc = 0.18 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 45.2998 +/- 0.0270 mas (same row, RUWE 1.25): 22.08 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.426 +/- 0.025 solar radii from Castro-González et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-244 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A..52C/abstract): 296,368 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.428 +/- 0.029 solar masses from Castro-González et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-244 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A..52C/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 3433 +/- 100 K from Castro-González et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-244 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A..52C/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Castro-González et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-244 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A..52C/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-244.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.811, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-244 (pscomppars): spectral type M2.5 V, from Castro-González et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A..52C/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, G 267-158: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-244 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.39 dex, from Castro-González et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A..52C/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-244 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -1.64264, from Castro-González et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A..52C/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-244 (pscomppars): age 7 Gyr, from Castro-González et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A..52C/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-244 (pscomppars): rotation period 53.3 d, from Castro-González et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...675A..52C/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
